title: Gardens, sumo show, then Ginza
call: Mostly dry, and the new plan fits it well. tenki.jp's hourly for Chiyoda has no rain until about 12:00, so the East Gardens at 09:15 are fine, 23 to 25°. The sumo show and chanko lunch from 12:00 are indoors, covering the brief shower around 13:00. Ginza car-free from 14:45 should be mostly dry, 21 to 23°, with another brief shower possible around 17:00, so carry an umbrella. Steadier rain from about 20:00 for dinner.
src: 55% chance of rain, tenki.jp weighted highest
